messages:
sam: FYI planning to enable artemis-v2 in catalog during 02:00-03:00 UTC window tonight. Need final fallback ordering, canary pin (api-edge), and rollback triggers.
tara: Canary plan? region targets and ramp?
sam: Start us-east 4% for 10m, then 25% global for 25m if metrics look good. Keep default unchanged.
jin: Perf note: artemis-v2 p50 ~+15% at long context, but quantized variant artemis-8q is close to baseline. Recommend quantized first in fallback.
tara: Quality gate: run eval/artemis_release_v1. Fail if semantic-match delta > 1% or safety regression > 0.2%. Also do one quick human review at 12m.
sam: Proposed rollback: p50 latency >2x baseline OR error-rate >0.5% sustained 5m OR eval regression > thresholds. Immediate rollback on OOMs or crashloops.
jin: +1. Also request fallback order: [artemis-8q, artemis-v2, orion-13b]. Verify artifacts uploaded.
orch-bot: catalog.enable queued by sam for artemis-v2. Change window: 02:00 UTC. Canary policy: us-east:4%->25% global. Fallback ordering set to [artemis-8q, artemis-v2, orion-13b]. Route pin: api-edge -> artemis@v2 (canary only).
ops-oncall: I will add alerts and dashboard. Pager policy: page infra if queue depth > 80 for 3m.
sam: Checklist: preflight eval pass, push fallback ordering, create canary route + pin, start canary, monitor, human spot-check, then promote or rollback.
jin: Artifact check: registry://models/artemis/8q present and checksum OK.
orch-bot: canary started at 5332109900 for artemis-v2 on api-edge (4% us-east). Monitoring hooks: telemetry/artemis-canary and alerts: latency-high, error-rate-high, eval-regression.
sam: 8m check: monitoring green, human spot-check ok. Proceeding to 25% ramp after 10m.
tara: Holding global promo until morning. Leave canary pinned.
orch-bot: canary update: 25% applied at 5332109960.
ops-oncall: saw a small p95 blip at minute 14 but within thresholds. No action.
jin: post-15m eval: semantic delta 0.3%, safety 0.05% => pass.
sam: Keep pinned and schedule global pin for 07:00 UTC if no issues. If rollback needed follow revert steps and open incident ticket with tags: catalog-rollout, artemis-v2, rollback.
tara: Release note draft: "artemis: canary enable v2 with quantized fallback preference. Latency and quality gates in place." I'll post changelog.
ops-oncall: ack, monitoring in place.
sam: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
